summary: The file is open in another program.
cause: Windows doesn't let YouLoader replace a file while another program, usually a music or video player, has it open.
suggestions: Close the program that's playing or showing the file.
Click Retry.

summary: YouLoader isn't allowed to save in this folder.
cause: Windows blocked writing to the folder. This happens with protected system folders, and when Windows Security's ransomware protection (“Controlled folder access”) doesn't know YouLoader yet.
suggestions: Choose a different folder with “Change…”.
Or allow YouLoader in Windows Security → Virus & threat protection → Ransomware protection → Allow an app through Controlled folder access.

cause: There wasn't enough free space to finish. Converting needs room for the download and the finished file at the same time.
suggestions: Free up some space, or choose a folder on another drive with “Change…”.
Click Retry.

summary: The file name or folder path is too long for Windows.
cause: Windows limits how long a file's full path can be, and this video's title plus your save folder went over it.
suggestions: Choose a save folder closer to the top of the drive, such as D:\Music.
Click Retry.

summary: The file couldn't be converted to this format.
cause: The converter (ffmpeg) couldn't fit part of the download, usually the cover art or an unusual audio stream, into the chosen format.
suggestions: Click Retry.
If it fails again, turn off “Embed cover art & tags”, or pick another format.
If it keeps happening, click “Report a problem” and paste the technical details.

cause: The connection most likely dropped partway through, so the file was incomplete and couldn't be converted.
suggestions: Click Retry.

cause: It was probably removed by antivirus software or a cleanup tool. YouLoader needs it to convert and merge files.
suggestions: Restart YouLoader. It downloads ffmpeg again automatically.
If your antivirus removed it, allow the folder %LocalAppData%\YouLoader\tools.

cause: The converter (ffmpeg) stopped without saying exactly why. The usual reasons are a damaged download or a file that's open in another program.
suggestions: Click Retry.
If it fails again, try another format.
If it keeps happening, click “Report a problem” and paste the technical details.

cause: Only the uploader and people they've invited can watch it, so there's nothing YouLoader can download.
suggestions: Check the link in your browser. If you can't watch it there either, it can't be downloaded.

summary: This video is for channel members only.
cause: The uploader made it available only to paying members of their channel. YouLoader doesn't sign in to YouTube, so it can't access it.
suggestions: There's nothing to fix on your side; this video can't be downloaded.

cause: YouTube only shows it to signed-in adults, and YouLoader never signs in to your account.
suggestions: There's nothing to fix on your side; age-restricted videos can't be downloaded.

summary: YouTube asked for a bot check.
cause: YouTube sometimes asks for this when it sees many downloads from one internet connection in a short time.
suggestions: Wait a while (an hour is usually enough) before downloading more.
Click “Update yt-dlp” at the bottom of the window, then Retry.

summary: YouTube is temporarily limiting your connection.
cause: Too many requests came from your internet connection in a short time, so YouTube is slowing it down for a while.
suggestions: Wait 15–30 minutes, then click Retry.
Download fewer videos at once.

cause: YouTube regularly changes how it delivers videos, and the download engine (yt-dlp) has to catch up. It can also happen briefly when YouTube limits a connection.
suggestions: Click “Update yt-dlp” at the bottom of the window, then Retry.
If it still fails, wait a few minutes and try again.

summary: This video is blocked in your country.
cause: The uploader or YouTube limited which countries can watch it.
suggestions: There's nothing to fix on your side; YouLoader can only download what you could watch in your browser.

cause: It's a scheduled premiere or live stream, so there's nothing to download until it has aired.
suggestions: Try again after the premiere or stream has finished.

cause: It was removed, made private, or the link is wrong.
suggestions: Open the link in your browser to check it still plays.
Make sure the whole link was copied.

summary: YouLoader can't download from this link.
cause: The link isn't a YouTube video, playlist or channel, or part of it is missing.
suggestions: Copy the link again from the address bar or the Share button.

summary: This quality isn't available for this video.
cause: The video isn't offered in the format or quality you picked.
suggestions: Pick another quality, such as “Best available”.
Click “Update yt-dlp” at the bottom of the window, then Retry.

cause: Your internet connection dropped, or the site didn't respond in time.
suggestions: Check that you're online.
Click Retry.

cause: yt-dlp.exe is missing or was blocked, often by antivirus software.
suggestions: Restart YouLoader. It downloads yt-dlp again automatically.
If your antivirus removed it, allow the folder %LocalAppData%\YouLoader\tools.
